name: data_catalog
description: Start here: every dataset (trades, quotes, bars, daily bars, movers index, stock-day finder, boards, order flow, halts, catalysts, symbols, splits, financials, SEC shares and filings, float, IPOs, ticker details, short interest, relative volume across every stock, cash runway and dilution filings, Nova's own recorded Level 2 and tape) with its source, history, as-of rule, units and the tool that reads it, plus what is NOT available.

name: data_status
description: What is on disk: each Massive dataset's days and indexed share, the movers index, past-day boards and the relative-volume table.

name: stock_day
description: One stock-day from the Massive files. kind: trades | quotes (NBBO, Level 1) | bars (tf 1m/5m/15m/1h from the minute file, 1s/10s built from trades; daily bars are not a stock-day read). day YYYY-MM-DD; start/end ET HH:MM (end exclusive). Volume: seconds bars count what the consolidated tape counts (no cancels, corrected originals or official open/close repeats); minute bars are Massive's own rule (no closing cross at 16:00, no prior-reference or odd-lot-only minutes), so seconds sum higher (GME 2021-01-27 09:30: 179,822 vs 179,397). Raw prices unless adjust=true (today's split terms). Inline answers hold 200 rows; output_name (new .parquet/.csv) for all. Bars exist only for buckets with a trade, so a halt or quiet stretch is a hole: meta.gaps lists each run of missing buckets in the window (first_et/last_et inclusive, ET; meta.gap_runs/gap_buckets count all, the longest 50 are listed) -- a plot by row index would hide it. fill_gaps=true adds a row per missing bucket with NO prices (nothing is carried or invented), volume 0 and filled=true.

name: movers_search
description: The agent movers endpoint (at most 500 rows): params like {"date_from": "2021-01-01", "high_min": 100, "price_max": 20, "float_max": 10000000, "sort": "high", "limit": 50}. Percents in points. float_max is SEC shares OUTSTANDING filed by the day (not free float; insiders and locked-up shares are inside it). splits: exclude_likely (default) | include | only_suspects.

name: movers_scan
description: Bulk day movers rows for research, past the 500-row cap. filters: date_from, date_to, price_min, price_max (prior close, raw $), high_min/high_max, low_*, close_*, gap_* (percent points: 50 = +50%), volume_min, dollar_volume_min. Needs date_from/date_to, a symbol or a limit; without a limit at most 100,000 rows (meta.capped says more matched; limit up to 1,000,000). splits: exclude_likely (default, the same rule as movers_search) | include | only_suspects; each row has split. Returned *_pct are percent points.

name: board
description: A past day's Scanner list at ET HH:MM as the Sim plays it back (recorded, else rebuilt): list_name gainers | losers | gappers | afterhours | large_cap. change_pct / gap_pct are percent points (45.6 = +45.6%), like the movers tools. Boards cover about 1,750 of 2,713 sessions (data_status counts them): a day without one answers covered=false with gap and note (0 rows then means no board, not no movers). data_status counts stored boards, not lists: gainers on a rebuilt day is the rebuilt market board (2016-11-30 to 2026-09-22) and the recorded gainers board takes over from 2026-09-23; large_cap exists only on recorded days (2026-09-23 on).

name: splits
description: A stock's splits (Massive + SEC-confirmed); with day, the factor that puts that day's raw prices in today's terms (shares divide by it), counting only the splits of the company that held the ticker that day. A ticker two companies used shows holder_cik per split and meta.ticker; cik picks one company.

name: financials
description: Massive financial statements as filed: statement balance_sheets | income_statements | cash_flow_statements; as_of YYYY-MM-DD keeps only filings on or before it (no look-ahead). Balance-sheet common_stock/treasury_stock are dollars, not shares. A reused ticker reads the company that held it on as_of (meta.ticker names it; an unsettled day errors with the candidate CIKs -- pass cik).

name: sec_shares
description: SEC share counts. With day: what filings said by that day -- outstanding (split-adjusted to the day), issued, treasury, 10-K public float in USD, and filer kind (domestic / foreign). Without day: every fact. The company is the one that held the ticker on day (ticker says who and whether the ticker was reused).

name: sec_filings
description: A company's SEC filings filed by as_of: forms e.g. ["4", "SC 13D", "SCHEDULE 13G", "424B4", "8-K", "10-Q", "20-F"]. Lists filings, not their contents. A reused ticker reads the company that held it on as_of.

name: float_latest
description: Massive's free float today (excludes insiders, 5%+ holders, locked-up shares). Latest only: never a past day's float.

name: ipos
description: IPOs by listing date (no lockup terms).

name: ticker_details
description: Ticker details as of the reference dump (name, CIK, exchange, SIC, list date, share class shares).

name: short_interest
description: FINRA short interest as published by day at ET HH:MM (a settlement counts only after its publish lag).

name: find_stock_days
description: Momentum stock-days in one call: movers rows (filters as movers_scan: date_from/date_to, price_min/max on the raw prior close, high_min ... in percent points; needs dates or a symbol) joined with what was known that day -- outstanding_* (SEC shares OUTSTANDING filed by the day, as of <=120 days, split-adjusted; NOT free float), enrichment_float (the desk's own float, 2026-07-28 on), catalyst_* (the backfill's verdict; null = unknown), halts / first_halt_et / halt_codes, pm_high / pm_volume and up10_et..up300_et (first ET minute each +N% printed). kinds: COMMON STOCK (CS, ADRC) by default, like movers_search -- warrants, rights, units and ETFs are left out unless asked: ["all"] keeps every kind, ["ETF"] or ["CS", "WARRANT"] those types; naming a symbol with no kinds keeps every kind. sort ranks the rows like movers_search: newest | oldest (default) | high | low | close | gap | volume | dollar_volume (a row without the figure last, ties newest day first); the float / catalyst / halted filters then pick from the ranking, so sort "high" with limit 10 is the ten largest highs that pass them. limit = page_size (the most rows this call returns, <=5,000; with output_name <=100,000); next_cursor continues the same ranking exactly: pass it back as cursor with the same arguments. float_max filters float_basis: sec_outstanding (default) | enrichment | best; outstanding_max is the same limit under the name of what it filters (SEC shares outstanding; needs float_basis sec_outstanding, not with float_max); float_source labels each value; float_unknown exclude | include | only. catalyst e.g. ["catalyst"] or ["unknown"]; catalyst_category e.g. ["fda_regulatory"] (the verdict's category); catalyst_words keeps a headline containing any word (e.g. ["approv", "clear"]: a text match, read the titles); halted true/false; halt_codes keeps a day with a halt of any code (e.g. ["T1", "LUDP"], or "news" / "luld" for their groups; a day the halt log does not cover is left out); news_halts / luld_halts count them. rvol_daily (the day's volume / its usual whole-session volume, up to 50 earlier sessions; null = unknown) on every row; rvol_daily_min e.g. 5 keeps 5x or more and leaves unknowns out, counted in meta.left_out. market_cap is an ESTIMATE: the prior close x SEC shares outstanding known that day (null when either is unknown), not the board's market cap; market_cap_min / market_cap_max (dollars) keep rows inside and leave unknowns out, counted in meta.left_out.market_cap_unknown. Likely splits left out (splits=include keeps).

name: daily_bars
description: Daily bars for a date range from the Massive day files (2016-01-04 on): open/high/low/close/volume, prev_close, change_pct / gap_pct / range_pct in percent points. Raw unless adjust=true (split-adjusted to as_of, default today, by the splits of the company that held the ticker each day). Day volume is the whole 04:00-20:00 session; prices are regular hours -- so a bar's volume can have built a range it does not show (FLYE 2026-09-01: high 2.79, but find_stock_days day_high 3.97 at 05:38 ET); stock_day_stats splits premarket, regular and whole-day. Day volume is the tape's from 2024-02-21; before, it leaves out prior-reference prints and corrected trades (AAPL 2024-02-20: 10.6% under), so an average across that date steps up.

name: market_context
description: The market around a day (default SPY, QQQ, IWM): each one's day change, gap, range, 5- and 20-session returns and close vs its 20-day average, plus a one-line summary. Nothing after the day is read.

name: stock_day_stats
description: One stock-day's numbers, computed from the Massive files: premarket volume/high/low and their times, first 5 and 30 minutes, regular session OHLC and the time of the high/low, VWAP (method stated), trade count and average trade size, median NBBO spread (cents and bps; window stated), relative volume by minute vs the prior rvol_days sessions, and daily rvol (day bars, so it reads high for ~20 sessions after 2024-02-21 and differs from rvol_scan's rvol_daily, which divides minute sums). Raw prices; units and methods in the answer's rules.

name: order_flow
description: Who traded, per minute (trades_flow_v1, built from every trade; 2016 on): vol, dvol, off-exchange (dark pool / wholesaler, exchange 4) off_pct, retail buys / sells by the sub-penny rule (a lower bound) with retail_imbalance -1..1, midpoint, sweeps (sweep_pct), odd lots, big prints ($25k+) and blocks ($200k+), shares by venue. start/end ET HH:MM; bucket 1m | 5m | 15m | 30m | 60m | day; meta.day_total sums the window. Definitions: docs/massive-builders.md.

name: halts
description: Trading halts (LULD pauses, news pending, ...) by symbol and/or day from Nova's halt log: one row per halt with start/end ET, duration, code and source. Needs a symbol or a day / date range; meta says the coverage and what each code means. codes keeps those halts: e.g. ["T1", "T12"], ["LUDP"], or "news" (T1-T3, T12) / "luld" (LULD and volatility pauses) for their groups.

name: catalysts
description: News items naming a stock in a window (data), plus the catalyst backfill's verdicts for its days (verdicts). at = 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' ET keeps only items published by then (no look-ahead). Coverage: Massive news is nearly empty before 2021-04 and verdicts exist only for days the backfill covered -- a missing one is unknown, never no news.

name: news_search
description: News across every stock in a date range (at most 366 days), no symbol needed. scope verdicts (default): one row per judged stock-day, newest first -- verdict e.g. ["catalyst"] (catalyst | negative | routine_only | noise_only | none_found), category e.g. ["fda_regulatory"], words in the deciding headline (a text match, e.g. ["approv", "clear"]); meta.categories counts every category in the range (the values category takes). scope items: every headline containing any of words (required), one row per item and stock it names. Only the backfill's target stock-days have verdicts and only its tickers have items: a stock-day in no row is unknown, never no news. Up to 5,000 rows (limit); output_name writes them.

name: journal_trades
description: The operator's own trades from the desk's journal (journal.db, read-only), newest first: symbol / setup exact (any case), tag one of the trade's tags, adherent true/false (followed the plan), date_from / date_to the ET day the trade opened -- the desk's own filter (GET /api/journal/trades). Rows: entry / exit / stop / target, qty, side, pnl, commission, tags, notes, opened_et / closed_et. Mock (test) rows only with include_mock. meta.summary sums the rows returned (closed, pnl, wins, losses); meta.journal_rows counts the real and mock rows in the file. The journal is not where the desk's fills land: the Account page reads the practice account's history (Paper, Sim) and IBKR's closed orders. limit default 200, up to 10,000.

name: symbols
description: Find a stock: query matches a ticker prefix or a company name; active true/false; types e.g. ["CS"]; exchange e.g. "XNAS" (primary exchange); cik every ticker a company used. With ticker: everything about it -- every company that used it and when, which one held it on day, a reused-ticker warning, and the company's other tickers (CIK history). Massive's list, latest dump.

name: cash_runway
description: A company's cash runway and dilution filings as known on a past day (YYYY-MM-DD; no look-ahead): the newest balance sheet's cash and short-term investments, the newest quarterly operating cash flow (burn), runway in months (null unless the cash and the burn are from the same quarter and cash is being used), shares outstanding growth over 4 and 8 quarters, and the S-1 / S-3 / F-1 / F-3 / 424B1-5 / 8-K filings in the lookback_days before the day (1-3650, default 1095) with their dates. Every figure names its statement's period_end and filing_date; unknown is null, never 0. Massive dates a period by the newest filing that carried it, so the newest statement known on a past day is often over a year old: read age_days / stale / notes. A filing is not an offering that closed. A reused ticker reads the company that held it that day (cik picks one).

name: rvol_scan
description: Relative volume of every common stock on every day, as of one ET clock time (at HH:MM: bars starting before it), from the relative-volume table (2016 on). Each row: date, symbol, kind, prev_close, price / price_et (the last bar's close and start), change_pct, volume (since 04:00), base_volume, rvol, volume_5m, base_5m, rvol_5m, day_avg_volume, rvol_daily, base_sessions, day_avg_sessions, split. filters: date_from, date_to (or symbol), price_min / price_max (prior close, $), rvol_min / rvol_max (on measure), volume_min (shares by at), change_min / change_max (percent points). measure: cumulative (volume since 04:00 / the prior sessions' mean to the same minute) | five_minute (the last 5 minutes / the same 5 minutes before) | daily_rate (volume since 04:00 / the mean whole-session volume of up to 50 sessions: the Five Pillars' "5x the 50-day average"). kinds default ["CS", "ADRC"] (also "unknown"); likely reverse splits left out (splits=include keeps); a measure needs min_base_sessions prior sessions (default 20). Sorted by the measure, largest first; 200 rows inline, rows counts all; output_name (new .parquet/.csv) for every row. Day facts, as find_stock_days (joined only when asked, for the rows the filters above kept): catalyst verdicts e.g. ["catalyst"] (["unknown"] = a day never judged); catalyst_category e.g. ["fda_regulatory"]; catalyst_words keeps a headline containing any word (e.g. ["approv"]: a text match); float_max on float_basis sec_outstanding (default: SEC shares OUTSTANDING filed by the day, NOT free float) | enrichment (the desk's own float, 2026-07-28 on) | best, float_unknown exclude | include | only; halted true/false; halt_codes e.g. ["T1", "LUDP"] or the groups "news" / "luld". Rows that pass add the asked parts' columns: catalyst_verdict / category / strength / title, float_shares / float_source / outstanding_*, halts / first_halt_et / halt_codes / luld_halts / news_halts. An unknown never passes: left out and counted in meta.left_out (catalyst_unknown, shares_unknown, halts_unknown), never read as no news or a small float.

name: rvol_triggers
description: The first minute each stock-day's relative volume reached rvol_min (5 = five times its baseline) inside [window_from, window_to) ET, with every filter holding at that bar -- e.g. the 6-7 AM surge. Rows: date, symbol, kind, prev_close, trigger_et (the bar's start), entry_et (its end: the first moment it is known), price (its close), change_pct, volume, base_volume, rvol, volume_5m, base_5m, rvol_5m, day_avg_volume, rvol_daily, above_before (already over the line before the window opened, so the window's first bar triggered; fresh=true leaves those out), base_sessions, split. filters: date_from, date_to (or symbol), price_min / price_max (prior close), volume_min (shares since 04:00 at the bar), change_min / change_max (percent points at the bar). measure: cumulative (volume since 04:00 / the prior sessions' mean to the same minute) | five_minute (the last 5 minutes / the same 5 minutes before) | daily_rate (volume since 04:00 / the mean whole-session volume of up to 50 sessions). Oldest day first; 200 inline, rows counts all. Day facts on the triggers, as rvol_scan and find_stock_days: catalyst (["catalyst"], ["unknown"] = never judged), catalyst_category (["fda_regulatory"]), catalyst_words (headline contains any), float_max on float_basis sec_outstanding (SEC shares outstanding, not free float) | enrichment | best with float_unknown exclude | include | only, halted, halt_codes (["T1", "LUDP"], "news", "luld"). Passing rows add the asked parts' columns (catalyst_*, float_shares / float_source / outstanding_*, halts / halt_codes ...); unknowns are left out, counted in meta.left_out.

name: rvol_outcomes
description: What came next: from every stock-day at clock time at (rvol_scan's rows) or from the first minute it crossed a line (trigger = {"rvol_min": 10, "measure"?, "window_from"?, "window_to"?, "fresh"?}; filters as rvol_triggers), did a bar's high reach +up_pct% or a low reach -down_pct% of the entry price first? The entry price is the close of the last bar before the entry clock; only later bars are read. horizon: close (before 16:00) | session (before 20:00) | days (days=1-20: then the next trading sessions' high / low on the entry's share basis; a horizon past the newest built session is left out as horizon_open). Outcomes up | down | same_bar (both in one minute: order unknown, never guessed) | same_day | neither. summary per group_by (rvol buckets on measure -- buckets edges, default 0,1,2,3,5,10,20,50,100,1000 -- or year | hour | none) plus all: entries, counts, p_up, p_down, p_up_resolved, median max up / down %, median and mean end %, median minutes to each line. Trigger entries get a control (on by default): one stock-day per trigger from the same date and universe that had not crossed the line by then, scored from the same clock. meta.left_out counts what was dropped. output_name writes every scored entry. Day facts, as rvol_scan / find_stock_days -- catalyst (["catalyst"], ["unknown"] = never judged), catalyst_category (["fda_regulatory"]), catalyst_words (headline contains any), float_max on float_basis sec_outstanding (SEC shares outstanding, not free float) | enrichment | best with float_unknown exclude | include | only, halted, halt_codes (["T1", "LUDP"], "news", "luld") -- narrow the entries AND the control pool (the same universe); unknowns are left out, counted in meta.left_out (catalyst_unknown, shares_unknown, halts_unknown). group_by also catalyst (the verdict) | catalyst_category | float (float_shares on float_basis: <5M, 5-10M, 10-20M, 20-50M, 50M+, each from its lower edge; meta. float_buckets); a stock-day with no value is the group "unknown" (never no news or a small float), and a control is grouped with its trigger.

name: recorded_depth
description: Nova's own recorded Level 2 book (what the desk's IBKR depth line showed) for a symbol at ET `at` (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS) on `day`: the newest book at or before that moment, never after, no older than max_age_sec (default 60, up to 3600), best price first with size per level, best_bid / best_ask / spread / mid. source: auto (the newer of the two stores) | capture (a Session Record: only symbols the operator or auto-record recorded, 2026-09-19 on, never read across a gap in the recording) | l2_db (the desk's depth samples). `tried` shows each store's answer; `coverage` states what each recording holds and lost (recorded stretches, gaps and why, books IBKR sent that the recording did not keep, sampling sessions). covered=false with a reason and recorded_days when nothing was recorded then: not "the book was empty". Times are ET on Nova's receive clock. Massive has no Level 2; this is Nova's own recording.

name: recorded_tape
description: Nova's own recorded Time & Sales prints for a symbol on `day`, ET start (inclusive) to end (exclusive), default the whole ET day, oldest first: time_et, ts (epoch seconds when Nova RECEIVED the print), receive_ts, exchange_ts (IBKR's own whole second, Session Records only), price, size, exchange, conditions, unreported, sets_price (may the print move a candle), side (ask | bid | between | unknown) / bid / ask (the desk's own judgement against the book it held at receipt; unknown when no usable book, never inferred), source. source: auto (a Session Record when one exists, else the archive) | capture | archive (every print the desk's tape line saw, 2026-07-15 on, any symbol). meta.coverage says what the recording holds and lost (a Session Record: stretches, gaps, tape losses; the archive: first / last print and that it marks no gap of its own); a Session Record's gaps may hold prints the archive has. limit up to 1,000,000 rows (meta.capped); inline answers hold 200, output_name (new .parquet/.csv) for all.

name: recorded_days
description: Which days the operator recorded, and which stocks each day: one row per Session Record (the recorder's folder <day>/<SYMBOL>, 2026-09-19 on), newest day first -- status, first_et / last_et and recorded_min of its recorded stretches, stretches, gaps and unplanned_gaps, and a problem when its manifest is unreadable (listed, never dropped). Filter by date_from / date_to (YYYY-MM-DD) and symbol. meta.days / meta.symbols count them. Not listed: the tape archive (every print the desk's tape line saw, 2026-07-15 on, any symbol) and l2.db -- recorded_tape / recorded_depth answer those per stock-day.

name: signal_catalog
description: Every signal of the Trader's Signals panel the signal table holds, for signal_test / signal_scan: its name, group (in_play, setups, front, float, halts, tape), kind (state ok | warn | bad | info | unknown, label with its values, number, bool), the desk rule that writes it, and how far back it reaches (most from 2016; boards, catalysts, halts, HOD Momo and the tape only partly). not_rebuilt names what has no history (borrow, HOD Momo's gate decisions, the Level 2 book walk). table: days built.

name: signal_series
description: One in-play stock-day's signals minute by minute (time_et the minute's start; each value as of its end), from in_play_et (the first minute it was in play: a bar 10%+ over the prior close, or 5x its relative volume, with 50,000+ shares) through 15:59; start / end (ET HH:MM, end exclusive) narrow it. signals: names from signal_catalog (default all). 200 rows inline; output_name writes every row.

name: signal_scan
description: Every stock in play by at (ET HH:MM: the minute before it, as of its end) on day, with every signal -- or only those meeting when (a list, all must hold: {"signal": "setup_first_pullback", "is": "triggered"}, {"signal": "pillars_n", "min": 4}, {"signal": "front", "is": ["Front side", "Mixed"]}). Highest relative volume first.

name: signal_test
description: Test a mix of the Trader's signals: the first minute in [window_from, window_to) ET each in-play stock-day met every condition of when (a list: {"signal", "is": value | [values]} or {"signal", "min"?, "max"?}; names and values from signal_catalog), entered at that minute's end at its price -- did a bar's high reach +up_pct% or a low -down_pct% first? fresh=true leaves out stock-days where it all held before the window. horizon close (before 16:00) | session (before 20:00) | days (days=1-20). filters: date_from, date_to (or symbol), price_min / price_max (prior close). Answers rvol_outcomes' shape: summary per group_by (year | hour | none) plus all -- entries, up, down, same_bar, same_day, neither, p_up, p_down, medians -- and a control (on by default): per entry one stock-day in play by the same minute of the same date where the mix had not held, scored the same way. meta.coverage names conditions on partly covered signals. output_name writes every scored entry.

name: sec_filings_scan
description: Who filed a form, across companies: every SEC filing of forms (required, matched exactly: ["424B5"], ["S-1", "S-1/A"], ["8-K"], ["SC 13D", "SCHEDULE 13D"]) filed date_from..date_to (YYYY-MM-DD, required, at most 31 days). Reads SEC's submissions.zip company by company -- every company in Massive's ticker list, active and delisted (a filer that never held a ticker Massive lists is not read unless ciks names it): about 7 s for a week, up to ~18 s for a broad form over a month, ~10 s more on a server's first SEC read; tickers (the company that held each on date_from and date_to), ciks or sic (SEC's own code today: "2834", or "283*" a prefix) narrow it. Rows: filed, accepted_et (SEC's acceptance time on its own clock, ET; accepted_clock says what placed it), form, ticker (the ticker the company held on the filing day, null before its listing), tickers (every ticker Massive gives the CIK), cik, company, sic, accession, report_date, items (8-K item numbers). A Form 4 or Schedule 13D/G is listed under the subject company too: each row names its own cik. Lists filings, not their contents; meta.scanned counts what was read. output_name (new .parquet/.csv) for all rows.

name: short_interest_scan
description: Which stocks had short interest of at least min_shares shares and / or min_days_to_cover days, at ONE FINRA settlement: settlement (YYYY-MM-DD, twice a month) or the newest one published by day at ET HH:MM -- the same publish lag as short_interest (a settlement counts from its 8th business day; meta.picked names it, and the newer one still pending). Every row is that settlement's: a stock missing from it is missing, never read from an older one. COMMON STOCK (CS, ADRC) by default; kinds ["all"] keeps ETFs, preferreds, warrants and OTC names Massive's list does not type (meta.left_out counts what kinds dropped). Rows: ticker (as FINRA writes it: ABRpD), cik and company (who held the ticker that settlement day), type, settlement_date, short_interest, avg_daily_volume, days_to_cover (999.99 is FINRA's cap), counts_from. sort short_interest | days_to_cover (largest first) | ticker.

name: sector_scan
description: Every listed company in an industry: SIC codes (["2834"], or ["283*"] for every code starting 283) OR words of the SIC description (["pharmaceutical"]: any word, any case), optionally on exchange (primary exchange: XNAS, XNYS, XASE, ARCX, BATS, "OTC Link") and active true/false. COMMON STOCK (CS, ADRC) by default; kinds ["all"] keeps warrants, units, preferreds. Rows: ticker, name, cik, sic, sic_description, exchange, list_date, type, active. SIC is the reference dump's LATEST (Massive ticker details), not as of a past day, and the dump has ticker details only for tickers active when it was taken: a delisted company is not here (sec_filings_scan's sic reads SEC's own code, delisted companies included).

name: nova_chart
description: Desk charts for 1 to 9 symbols on one date. Post chat_message verbatim. symbols: tickers. date: YYYY-MM-DD. as_of: HH:MM Eastern, default 16:00. Timeframes are fixed: 10s, 1m, 5m, 1d, full session 04:00 to 16:00 ET. One link per symbol, plus a gallery link. PNG previews are image blocks. Volume: the 10s 16:00 bar holds the closing cross, the 1m bar does not. The date's 1d candle is its minute bars to as_of (no closing cross or after-hours, high may be premarket); prior 1d candles are official day bars, so the last candle's volume sits under the day bar's even at 16:00.
